up: Find all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5727410. Return the ChEMBL identifier and preferred name of each molecule. Use the docs table to identify the document, then join compound_records to get the molecules listed in that document, and finally join molecule_dictionary to retrieve molecule details.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727410';
